Compute fraction from the above multiplication. Write it in the simplest form.
Fill in the boxes from left to right, top to bottom. Do not skip any boxes.
Solution: The two denominators being multiplied are 8 and 5 (in either order). Multiply the numerators to get 63 and multiply the denominators: 8 x 5 = 40. The product is 63/40.
Cross-cancel: 6 and 4 share a factor of 2 (6 becomes 3, 4 becomes 2); 13 and 39 share a factor of 13 (13 becomes 1, 39 becomes 3). Then (3/3) x (1/2) = 3/6 = 1/2.

Question Choices: You have 2/7 of a ktoinfinity worksheet left for HW. You finish 1/3 of what is left today. How much of the worksheet did you complete today?
Solution: 1/3 of 2/7 means (1/3) x (2/7) = (1 x 2)/(3 x 7) = 2/21. You completed 2/21 of the worksheet today.
